# Challenge the Footage

> One account for evidence + legal document templates. Free first generation / $9 packs via Stripe. Public defenders free. Not legal advice. No crypto wallet required.

This file helps AI agents find canonical entry points. Prefer `Accept: text/markdown` on HTML routes for machine-readable content.

## Primary pages

- [Home / generator](https://challengethefootage.com/): Case details form + four document types
- [Evidence](https://challengethefootage.com/evidence.html): Record encounters + evidence library
- [Public defenders](https://challengethefootage.com/public-defenders.html): Free unlimited access program
- [Terms of Service](https://challengethefootage.com/terms.html): Legal terms
- [Agent instructions](https://challengethefootage.com/AGENTS.md): How agents should use this site
- [Auth for agents](https://challengethefootage.com/auth.md): Google Sign-In / OAuth notes
- [Product model](https://github.com/danielsmithdevelopment/surveillance-evidence-integrity/blob/main/challenge-tool/PRODUCT.md): Unified product (evidence + docs + Stripe)

## Related open-source repo

- [surveillance-evidence-integrity](https://github.com/danielsmithdevelopment/surveillance-evidence-integrity): Model contracts, legislation, technical standards
- [Witness module](https://github.com/danielsmithdevelopment/surveillance-evidence-integrity/tree/main/witness): Optional native capture client for CTF
- [ClawQL](https://clawql.com): Inference, memory, Stripe, independent evidence anchoring (invisible to end users)
